content.what_it_is: MATLAB 예제 스크립트로, 선택한 FUNWAVE 격자의 원점·차원에서 UTM 경계 두 점을 위경도로 변환하고 1차원 위도·경도 좌표를 만든다(L31-L56). 프레임 40..160의 eta와 mask 이진 배열을 읽어 마스크 밖을 NaN으로 만든 뒤(L67-L86), 위성 지도 위에 수면고를 pcolor로 겹쳐 각 프레임을 `movie5.avi`에 기록한다(L88-L119).
entities: script workspace reset by clear all @L1
view variables look_height, look_h, look_v and col @L11-L14
frame list fnames and color bounds cmax/cmin @L26-L29
coordinate vectors lat,lon and limits latG,lonG @L49-L53
fileID, eta, and mask frame arrays @L76-L86

mask single-precision array with selected DimsX
satellite basemap using configured API key argument

calls: sprintf for frame number and time @L69-L70
unresolved: The selected dataset is region=5 at L3 and all grid indexing uses GridX{region}/DimsX{region} at L35-L39 and L77/L82, but the highlight polygon is unconditionally built from ax2 at L109-L110; ax5 defined at L9 is unused, indicating a cross-region copy/paste mismatch in the plotted box.
The map call at L94 passes the literal placeholder API key `your key here`; unless edited before execution, the satellite basemap request lacks a usable credential.

fopen results at L76 and L81 and fread element counts at L77 and L82 are not checked before transpose and paired masking at L79-L86; missing or short files can propagate invalid file identifiers or dimensionally inconsistent eta/mask arrays, and an error before L119 leaves vidObj open.

Only the lower-left and diagonally opposite UTM points are converted at L46-L47, then latitude and longitude are independently interpolated at L49-L50; this assumes a rectilinear geographic grid and does not transform each UTM row/column, so projection curvature or grid rotation is discarded.

look_height/look_h/look_v/col at L11-L14, fdir_depth at L18, and ax1/ax3/ax4/ax5 at L5/L7-L9 are never consumed through EOF L121, consistent with copied configuration that is not wired into the active plot path.
